description: Repair and redecoration to front and rear elevations, to main roof, and to low-level roofs to the rear elevation. Stucco render repairs and restoration including cornices and embellishments to front elevation. Render repairs to rear elevation and chimney stacks. Doff cleaning of render to chimney stacks. Brickwork and stonework repairs to rear elevation. Brickwork and stonework cleaning to rear elevation. Joinery repairs to windows and doors. Replacement of cracked glazing. Overhaul of rainwater disposal systems. Metalwork repairs. Flat roof, box gutter, and balcony asphalt repairs. Roof felt and slate repairs. Leadwork repairs. Cable tidy. Cleaning of hard-standings. External redecoration of previously decorated surfaces.
